bearerAuth.description: A personal API token (`wm_pat_…`) created in Settings → API tokens. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer wm_pat_…`. Tokens are shown once; store them like a password.

appuserKey.description: The member the money is attributed to; null for Shared (a joint account, or someone no longer in the household).

attribution.description: The account’s attribution: its owner, or Shared when joint.

isJoint.description: A joint account: its money is Shared in reports and the member filter.

details.description: Values to word the error with (4xx only).

unavailableCount.description: Transactions in the proposal the caller can no longer see; they are left out of `changes`.

after.description: The proposed value: a category name, `true` for reviewed, or the note (null clears it).

before.description: The current value, read when the response is built.

period.description: The days the budget month covers: with start day 25, month 11 runs from 25 October to 24 November.

periodStartDay.description: The day of the month a budget month starts on, 1 to 28. With 1 a budget month is its calendar month; with a later day it is named after the month it ends in.

period.description: The days the budget month covers: with start day 25, month 11 runs from 25 October to 24 November.

periodStartDay.description: The day of the month a budget month starts on, 1 to 28. With 1 a budget month is its calendar month; with a later day it is named after the month it ends in.

unpricedSymbols.description: Ticked tokens with a balance and no price at the last sync.

address.description: The public address, normalised (bech32 lower-case, Ethereum EIP-55 checksummed), or the xpub/ypub/zpub.

errorCode.description: Why the last attempt failed; null unless status is failed.

lastSyncedAt.description: The last successful read; the token balances are as of then.

native.description: The chain's own coin (BTC, ETH) rather than an ERC-20 token.

contractAddress.description: The ERC-20 contract, lower-case; null for the native coin.

quantity.description: The balance in whole units, as an exact decimal string.

tracked.description: Ticked: counts towards the wallet's value. Detected tokens start unticked.

priceMissing.description: Ticked with a balance and no price at the last sync, so that day's value was not written.

settlementAmount.description: Signed, in `currencyCode`; the user’s edit when there is one.

value.description: Today's value in the asset's currency; null when it has none (archived).

LoanSecuredAsset.description: The asset the loan is secured against, or null. Presentation only: net worth is unchanged.

kind.description: A `crypto_wallet` is valued in USD by the daily sync of its public addresses, never by hand.

linkedLoans.description: The viewer's loans secured against the asset. Loans are personal, so other members' loans are not listed.

linkedDebt.description: Their total outstanding principal in the asset's currency: 0 with none, null when a loan has no exchange rate.

equity.description: Today's value less linkedDebt, in the asset's currency. Null when the asset has no value today or linkedDebt is null.

unconvertedLoanCurrencies.description: Currencies of linked loans no rate converts into the asset's currency.

outstandingPrincipal.description: Today's outstanding principal in the loan's currency.

outstandingPrincipalInAssetCurrency.description: The same in the asset's currency at the latest rate; null when no rate exists.

suggested.description: The preset matching the person's language and country, if any.

rules.description: Every rule in the preset, in the rules export format, with what installing would do with it.

code.description: The preset code, such as pt-PT.

countries.description: Countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) whose merchants the preset knows.

installed.description: Whether the household already has every rule in the preset.

installedCount.description: Preset rules the household already has a rule of the same name for.

fingerprint.description: Identifies the suggestion: its pattern and category.

kind.description: The pattern: the same merchant, or the same cleaned description prefix.

matchCount.description: Transactions the member moved this way within the window, this change included.

appuserKey.description: The member the money is attributed to; null for Shared (a joint account, or someone no longer in the household).

overridden.description: True when the transaction sets its own attribution ("Spent by"); false when it follows its account.

website.description: The merchant’s https website, as the household set it.

logoUrl.description: An https image the household set for the merchant.

resolvedLogoUrl.description: The image to show: `logoUrl` when set, else this API’s logo proxy for the website’s domain when the instance configures `MERCHANT_LOGO_URL_TEMPLATE`, else null (show the initial).

remainingAmount.description: What can still be linked: the absolute amount less `linkedAmount`.

role.description: Money out is an expense, money in a reimbursement.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write`.

Categorise, hide or unhide, mark reviewed, or add and remove tags on many transactions in one request. Select them with `transactionIds`, or with `filter`, the filters of `GET /v1/account/transaction` (every matching row, hidden ones only with `includeHidden`). At most 5,000 transactions; a filter matching more is refused with `bulk_selection_too_large`. A filter key the list does not take is an error. A recategorization answers a `ruleSuggestion` as `PATCH /v1/account/transaction/:transactionId` does, counting each row it moved.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write`.

The path transaction is the refund (money in). Both must be in the same settlement currency (400 `reimbursement_currency_mismatch`), and the links on either side cannot exceed its amount (400 `reimbursement_amount_exceeded`). Unlinking needs a session: a token cannot delete.

**Required scope:** any of `read`, `write`.

For a refund: expenses of the 60 days before it, from the same merchant or for at least its amount. Same currency only, with something left to link. `search` matches the description or merchant instead.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read`.

Changes the in-app assistant or an MCP client (`mcp:propose`) drafted for the token's owner, newest first, each with a live before/after preview. `status` defaults to `pending`; a pending proposal past `expiresAt` (seven days) is not listed as pending. Applying or dismissing one is only possible in the app, signed in: no token scope reaches those routes. Answers 403 `feature_disabled` when the person turned AI off.
